acceptance_criteria: The deterministic schedule contains exactly 90 unique cases, 10 complete world-by-environment-seed blocks, nine cases per block and 30 cases per method family.

Every case reaches exactly 600 simulation seconds after its first valid global waypoint, has all required type-correct nonempty ROS topics, finite evaluator outputs and zero replacement-planner failed cycles.
Every raw bag is compressed with zstd level 10 and its decompressed SHA-256 equals the original bag SHA-256 before the uncompressed bag is removed.

The primary 0.5 m coverage-time AUC and all registered secondary/stability metrics are computed for all 90 cases with the frozen block analysis, exact sign-flip test, 10,000-sample bootstrap and Holm correction.
Training, optimizer steps, C09 reads, C10 reads, checkpoint selection, case retries, frame deletion and result-driven schedule changes are all zero.
baseline: Original M-TARE with the qualified explicit planner_seed patch is the primary baseline. The layered complete-development-map Oracle is the necessary non-deployable upper-bound fallback/reference. There is no retry or alternate metric fallback.

estimated_cost.compute: Serial CPU plus Gazebo/ROS; 54,000 simulation seconds; zstd-10 lossless archives; no GPU, training or optimizer use.

expected_evidence: Approved Data Card, matrix, exact randomized schedule and frozen identities.
Ninety per-case contracts, logs, lossless bags, topic audits, trajectories, coverage curves, waypoints, metrics and exit states.
Sixty replacement-planner graph snapshots and decision traces, plus original M-TARE internal logs for 30 baseline cases.
Ten-block family summaries, M1D-minus-M-TARE effect estimates, confidence intervals, p-values, stability metrics, aggregate summary, RUN_STATE and SHA-256 seal.
method: Run the approved randomized 90-case matrix serially: two development worlds by five environment seeds; original M-TARE three repeats, frozen M1D seeds 0/1/2 once each, and the non-deployable complete-map Oracle three repeats per block; retain identical simulator, LiDAR, terrain, localPlanner, pathFollower, control, 600-second budget and 0.5 m coverage evaluator.
question: Does frozen M1D causal-topology global planning improve coverage-time efficiency over original M-TARE in same-stack single-robot closed loop, while exposing full-system and model-seed stability?
stop_conditions: Any frozen input, image, planner binary, checkpoint, matrix or tool hash drift.
Any startup, topic, time-budget, finite-value, graph/decision-trace, storage, disk-floor or evidence failure; stop and seal FAIL without retry.
Any attempt to read C09/C10, train, select a checkpoint/parameter, delete a failed case or reorder from outcomes.

user_authorization.confirmation_reference: After the exact A/B choice, case counts, duration, storage and evidence were shown, the user replied '批准'.
user_authorization.scope: One immutable Gate-6 run of exactly 90 cases and 54,000 simulation seconds under randomized-block design A, with expected 17-20 wall hours and 103-120 GB losslessly compressed evidence.
